overview.description: The AllianzIM U.S. Equity 6 Month Buffer10 May/Nov ETF (SIXZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust over a specific holdings period. The actively-managed fund holds options and collateral. SIXZ was launched on Apr 30, 2024 and is issued by Allianz.
